references.text: The expression 'worthless men' (bene-beliyaal) is also used here of men who commit serious sins against society
Same theme about serving other gods and the punishment for idolatry in Israel
Warning against those who turn away to serve the gods of other peoples
Warning that some will lead the people astray to serve other gods
Eli's sons are called 'worthless men' (bene beliyaal) who did not know the Lord
The expression 'worthless men' is used of those who dig up evil
Warning against being led astray to serve other gods
Paul uses the word Beliar as a contrast to Christ, a connection to the concept of beliyaal
